customManagers.description: The images of the package builds, pinned by digest in the matrix of packages.yml.

packageRules.description: Crates: minor and patch updates together. Cargo.lock is kept to versions that build with rust-version (resolver 3), which Renovate never changes.
aya 0.15 needs Rust 1.98, and Debian 13 (backports) has 1.96. Remove this rule together with the limit in keyboard-state/Cargo.toml when rust-version is 1.98.
aya-obj 0.4 and later go with aya 0.15 and later (see above). Remove this rule together with that one.
Actions: a new version is not taken before it has been out for three days.
The base images of the package builds, of the local containers and of the container of the aports job, pinned by digest: their updates together in one pull request.

The tag of a package build image is the distribution release that the job builds for, and the job is named after it: Renovate updates only its digest by itself. A new tag (a new release) is only listed on the Dependency Dashboard, as a sign to add an entry of its own to the matrix; the old release stays until its support ends. The group of their own keeps them out of the branch of the digests: Renovate takes an update in a branch that is already there as approved.
